title: Michael's medical exam and injection (sodium pentothal)
place_text: Ellsworth AFB medical facility, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I just remember I just remember they shot some some in me uh something in my vein and stuff and uh

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says that in 1977, at the medical facility of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he was examined and injected in the vein with something, which the story names as sodium pentothal, a sedative drug. He tells it himself, saying only that he remembers "they shot something in me, in my vein," as part of his account of an abduction while he served at the base and what followed it.
